data.title: Sunshine Oilsands to Issue Discounted Shares to Settle Debt
data.description:
Sunshine Oilsands ( (HK:2012) ) has shared an update.

Sunshine Oilsands has agreed to issue new shares under its existing general mandate to settle outstanding debts owed to certain creditors, converting liabilities into equity. The shares will be issued at HK$0.171, a discount to recent market prices, and will account for about 13.85% of current share capital, or 12.16% of the enlarged capital base once the transaction closes.

The issuance, which does not require additional shareholder approval, is intended to strengthen the company’s balance sheet by reducing debt obligations but will dilute existing shareholders’ stakes. Completion remains subject to conditions in the settlement agreement, and the company has warned investors to exercise caution, underscoring some execution risk and potential volatility around the stock as the deal proceeds.

data.title: China Environmental Technology Reaches Settlement Over Disputed Convertible Bonds
data.description:
China Environmental Technology Holdings Limited ( (HK:0646) ) has shared an announcement.

China Environmental Technology Holdings has settled a long-running dispute over its 2021 convertible bonds by signing a Deed of Settlement with creditor Sure Fast. The agreement follows prior court rulings affirming the validity and enforceability of the bond-related agreements, bringing greater clarity to the company’s financial obligations.

Under the Deed, the company will pay a final settlement sum of US$11.29 million plus interest in three instalments through the end of 2027. In return, Sure Fast has agreed not to pursue winding-up petitions, new legal actions, or enforcement of the Hong Kong High Court judgment, unless the company defaults, reducing immediate legal and insolvency risks for shareholders and creditors.

data.description:

The mandate, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting, would enable the bank to issue up to about 47.9 billion A shares and 4.6 billion H shares, with pricing linked to the recent average trading price and authority to adjust registered capital and amend its articles accordingly.

Under this general mandate, the bank has drawn up an A share issuance plan to place new shares with specified investors, after confirming it meets regulatory requirements under Chinese company and securities laws. data.title: Gamivo S.A. Named in California Class-Action Lawsuit Over GAMIVO.com Fees

The lawsuit challenges how certain fees and services are presented and charged during the purchase process on the GAMIVO.com platform, though the plaintiff has not specified the value of the claims.

The company stresses that Gamivo S.A. is not the operator of the GAMIVO.com platform nor the entity processing consumer transactions, asserting that GAMIVO.com Limited manages sales, payments and order fulfillment. Management is disputing the legitimacy of the claims against the Polish parent, is working with legal advisors to assess its defense, and says it is currently unable to estimate any potential financial impact, with further updates to follow in line with disclosure rules.

data.title: Asep Medical Restructures Stakes in ABT and Sepset While Preserving Economic Upside
data.description:

Asep Medical Holdings Inc., a biotechnology-focused investment issuer based in Victoria, BC, concentrates on diagnostic and therapeutic medical technologies, including sepsis diagnostics through Sepset Biosciences and anti-biofilm solutions via ABT Innovations. The company leverages a global patent portfolio originating from research led by microbiologist Dr. Robert E. W. Hancock at the University of British Columbia to address significant unmet medical needs and attract both retail and institutional investors.

Asep has agreed to reduce its indirect common shareholdings in ABT Innovations and Sepset Biosciences from 50.1% to 45% in exchange for settling intercompany debt and receiving preferred shares in each entity, preserving its economic exposure through a royalty-like entitlement to net profits. Despite the Canadian Securities Exchange reclassifying Asep as an investment company, the firm will retain substantial governance rights, continue to support and finance the development and commercialization of ABT and Sepset technologies and pursue strategic expansion opportunities, including in India and China, aiming to enhance long-term value for stakeholders.

data.title: Bharat Road Network sets September AGM to clear FY26 accounts and related-party framework
data.description:

Bharat Road Network Ltd. has scheduled its nineteenth Annual General Meeting for 30 September 2026 at 2:30 p.m. IST, to be conducted via video conferencing and other audio-visual means, with the company’s registered office in Kolkata designated as the deemed venue. Shareholders will consider and adopt the audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026, with the annual report made available through the company’s website and via communication to investors whose email addresses are not registered.
